landing.title: From inquiry to payout, <hl>without the spreadsheets</hl>
landing.intro: StageDesk gives your agency one place for inquiries, quotes, planning, artists and payments. Your customers book through your own page; your artists get paid automatically after the party.
landing.previewLabel: Example of the booking overview in StageDesk
landing.featuresIntro: Built around how agencies actually work: a lot of inquiries, a handful of artists, and every weekend full.
landing.feature_inquiriesBody: Every agency gets a booking page and a form for its own website. Inquiries land in your queue straight away.
landing.feature_quotesBody: Lines from your service catalogue, VAT done right, a deposit and an expiry date. Customers accept with one click.
landing.feature_planningBody: A calendar of every event, artist availability, and reminders before quotes expire and events start.
landing.feature_artistsBody: Ask an artist, they accept in the app and get the full brief. Share artists with partner agencies.
landing.feature_paymentsBody: Customers pay by iDEAL or card. After the event the artist's share and yours are paid out automatically.
landing.feature_messagesBody: Messages per booking with the customer and the artist, live notifications, and email when it matters.
landing.moneyTitle: Money that arrives where it should
landing.moneyIntro: No more transferring artist fees by hand. The split is agreed when the customer accepts, and paid out after the event.
landing.money1: The customer pays the deposit and balance online, with iDEAL or card.
landing.money2: After the event, and a short wait for disputes, StageDesk splits the payment.
landing.money3: The artist's share goes to the artist; the rest goes to your agency.

landing.faq1Q: Do my customers need an account?
landing.faq1A: No. They sign in with a code we email them, and only to see their event, quote and payments.
landing.faq2Q: Can I keep using bank transfers?
landing.faq2A: Yes. You can record offline payments in the booking. Online payments are optional.
landing.faq3A: With online payments, the artist connects a Stripe account once and receives their share automatically after each event. Otherwise you pay them as you do now, and StageDesk shows what's still owed.
landing.faq4Q: Is my data stored in the EU?
landing.faq4A: Yes. StageDesk runs on servers in the EU, and we sign a data processing agreement with every agency.
landing.faq5A: Yes. You can cancel your subscription whenever you like; it stops at the end of the period you've paid for.
landing.waitlistIntro: StageDesk opens soon. Leave your email and we'll let you know.
landing.closingIntro: Set up your agency in an afternoon. Free to try.

landing.showArtistsPoint1: Accept or decline in one tap
landing.showPayoutsBody: Customers pay their deposit and balance with iDEAL or card. After the event StageDesk splits the payment between the artist, your agency and the platform.
landing.showPayoutsPoint2: Split agreed when the quote is accepted
landing.faq6Q: Can I use StageDesk for bands and live music as well as DJs?
landing.faq6A: Yes. StageDesk works for every kind of act: DJs, bands, singers, saxophonists and MCs. Each artist has their own profile, share and availability.
landing.faq7Q: Can I put the booking form on my own website?
landing.faq7A: Yes. Paste one line of code and the form appears on your site. It adapts to the width of the page and sends inquiries straight to your queue.
landing.faq8Q: How long does it take to get started?
landing.faq8A: Most agencies are set up in an afternoon: add your details, services and artists, switch on your booking page, and you're ready for your first inquiry.

about.intro: StageDesk Pro brings inquiries, quotes, artist planning and payments together, so agencies spend their time on music and customers instead of admin.
about.story1: Entertainment agencies run on weekends. Inquiries come in by email, WhatsApp and phone; quotes live in Word; artists are found by calling around; and the money is transferred by hand after every party.

about.value_togetherBody: Agencies, artists and partners work together; StageDesk makes that easy.

partnerPages.faqMeta: Questions about the StageDesk partner program
partnerPages.faqMetaDescription: Answers about joining, commission, payouts and what counts as a referral.
partnerPages.faq1A: Anyone who reaches DJ, band or entertainment agencies: consultants, wedding planners, venues, trainers, writers and artists with a network.
partnerPages.faq2A: No. Joining and taking part are free.
partnerPages.faq3Q: When does an agency count as a referral?
partnerPages.faq3A: When a new agency signs up through your link (within the cookie period) or uses your promo code. A code at sign-up wins over a link.
partnerPages.faq4A: Once the agency's payment is confirmed. Then there's a waiting period; after that you can withdraw.
partnerPages.faq5A: You choose Stripe, bank transfer or PayPal and request a withdrawal. We approve and pay; you see every step.
partnerPages.faq6Q: What if an agency stops or gets a refund?
partnerPages.faq6A: If an agency stops, commission on new invoices stops. If a payment is refunded before you've withdrawn it, its commission lapses.
partnerPages.faq7Q: Can I refer my own agency?
partnerPages.faq7A: No. Sign-ups from your own account or email domain don't count.
partnerPages.faq8Q: Can I advertise on the StageDesk name?
partnerPages.faq8A: Not on the brand name in search engines. Other ads and content are welcome; get in touch if in doubt.
partnerPages.faq9Q: Does the agency get something too?
partnerPages.faq9A: Yes: with your code or link the agency gets a discount on the first months of its subscription.
partnerPages.faq10Q: Can I see what my links bring in?
partnerPages.faq10A: Yes. Your partner area shows clicks, sign-ups and paying agencies per campaign.
